name: IncludeCallback
signature: public delegate IncludeResult? IncludeCallback(string headerName, bool isSystem, string requestingName)

docs.summary: Resolves an `#include`. `headerName` is the text between the quotes or angle brackets, `isSystem` is true for the `<name>` form, and `requestingName` is the [`Name`](#api~Prowl.Prism.Glsl.IncludeResult) of the file holding the directive ("" for the main source). Returns null when the header cannot be found, which is a compile error.
